purpose: Define a resumable, source-grounded search and review workflow for discovering future TensorCircuit benchmark problem families.
claim_boundary: Search hits, design scores, and human plausibility judgments are not evidence that a model cannot solve a candidate. A model-hardness claim requires the separately frozen expert, verifier, pilot, and confirmation workflow.

automation_boundary.behavior: This file is a machine-readable contract. An operator or a future runner must configure and invoke a conforming adapter; importing or validating this JSON must perform no network access.

terminology.raw_search_record: One immutable result returned by one query page; it is not yet accepted scientific evidence.
terminology.source_snapshot: One content-addressed, normalized snapshot of a paper, official document, dataset, or benchmark source.
terminology.problem_lead: One source-grounded computational problem hypothesis before semantic deduplication and coverage sampling.
terminology.problem_family: A deduplicated problem mechanism with an explicit TensorCircuit path and an independently checkable oracle design.
terminology.candidate_contract: A problem family instantiated at one resource scale and one operational situation.
terminology.design_prior: A pre-trial score used for triage; it must not contain or imply empirical model performance.
terminology.model_hard_evidence: Evidence produced only by the separately authorized frozen-model trial protocol.

artifact_policy.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with object keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace, and a trailing newline only for stored files.
artifact_policy.secret_policy: Never persist credentials, authorization headers, cookies, signed URLs, or full environment dumps. Persist only the names of credential variables used.

resume_contract.idempotency_key: sha256(protocol_id, research_run_id, stage_id, canonical unit input)
resume_contract.resume_rule: On resume, verify the input manifest and output ledger hashes, skip completed idempotency keys, and continue pending units from their recorded cursor. Never infer completion from file existence alone.
resume_contract.invalidation_rule: A changed protocol, adapter version, query definition, normalized source snapshot, quota policy, score rubric, or human decision creates a new input manifest hash and invalidates downstream checkpoints without deleting prior artifacts.
resume_contract.failure_rule: Record terminal and retryable failures as ledger events. A failed page or source remains pending until retried, explicitly waived by a human, or excluded with a reason code.

query_strategies.purpose: Map scientifically meaningful computational tasks across the principal quantum-computing domains rather than beginning from a preferred algorithm.
query_templates: {facet} quantum computing benchmark task exact verifier
{facet} quantum numerical method primary paper implementation
query_strategies.expected_yield: Broad problem mechanisms and authoritative benchmark definitions.

query_strategies.purpose: Find the same computational obstruction under different subfield terminology and avoid counting vocabulary variants as independent ideas.
query_strategies.expected_yield: Synonym maps, related formulations, and semantic-dedup candidates.

query_strategies.purpose: Search around TensorCircuit-native representations and methods so that the framework performs the core quantum computation.
query_strategies.expected_yield: Pinned public-API evidence, feasible framework paths, and framework-obstruction warnings.

query_strategies.purpose: Find scientifically substantive failure modes that create reasoning or numerical difficulty without merely increasing brute-force size.
query_strategies.expected_yield: Mechanistic difficulty priors and explicit falsification tests; not automatic model-hardness evidence.

query_strategies.purpose: Locate reusable task structures, public datasets, independent oracles, and direct evidence of agent capability gaps.
query_templates: quantum task suite verifier public instances {facet}
query_strategies.expected_yield: Benchmark context and, when directly measured, model-specific agent evidence.

minimum_raw_search_records_per_strategy.note: A provider may return fewer useful records; a waiver must record exhaustion evidence rather than silently lowering the quota.

expected_candidate_contract_count.derivation: 50 problem families x 4 scale regimes x 5 operational situations

minimum_direct_agent_evidence_candidates.note: Absence of direct agent evidence does not reject a scientifically strong candidate, but must remain visible.

immutable_record_contracts.mutation_policy: Records are immutable snapshots. Corrections append a new record with supersedes_record_id and preserve every prior record and raw payload.

raw_search_record.identity_rule: raw_record_id is the SHA-256 of the canonical record excluding raw_record_id and supersedes_record_id.

source_snapshot.identity_rule: source_snapshot_id is a SHA-256 over normalized metadata, identifier versions, raw provenance IDs, and license review; later paper or documentation versions create new snapshots.

redistribution_rules: Raw source content with restricted or unknown licensing stays outside the repository in the gitignored artifact store.
Unknown licensing does not prevent recording bibliographic metadata and a canonical link, but it prevents committing the downloaded payload.
Search snippets are discovery hints only and must not be treated as scientific evidence.
Committed excerpts must be necessary, short, attributed, and permitted by the source license; evidence locators are preferred over copied text.
source_admission_requirements: Resolve and record a stable DOI, arXiv identifier with version, official release tag or commit, or content-hashed official documentation snapshot when one exists.
Record whether the work is a preprint, peer-reviewed publication, official documentation, benchmark release, corrected work, or retracted work.
Reject retracted evidence as a scientific basis unless the task explicitly studies the retraction and a human approves that use.
Mutable latest-documentation URLs require a captured content hash and a framework package version or source commit.
Every normalized factual claim needs a source_snapshot_id and a section, page, equation, figure, table, API symbol, or dataset-field locator.

problem_family_admission_requirements.software_feasibility_rule: Use pinned official API or release evidence for framework-specific claims; a general framework paper alone is insufficient for a new or nightly API.
problem_family_admission_requirements.secondary_source_rule: A secondary review may seed queries and supply vocabulary but may not be the sole scientific basis.
problem_family_admission_requirements.agent_evidence_rule: Only a benchmark or trial that names the evaluated model, version or snapshot, prompt/tool policy, trial count, and outcome may populate agent_evidence. Generic complexity, barren-plateau, or NP-hardness results remain design priors.
problem_family_admission_requirements.oracle_rule: At least one cited source or independently specified derivation must justify the physical quantity and conventions checked by the oracle.

semantic_deduplication.source_version_rule: Different arXiv versions, corrected publications, software releases, or documentation builds remain distinct source snapshots linked by a common source_id.
semantic_deduplication.automatic_action: Create review clusters only. Never automatically delete, merge, or suppress a problem lead based on semantic similarity.
review_requirements: A reviewer compares the full problem contracts and supporting source snapshots, not titles or embeddings alone.
same_problem requires a canonical representative and an explanation of which mechanism, input-output contract, and oracle coincide.
related_variant_keep_both requires a scientifically material distinction and states how hidden tests will distinguish the variants.
A second reviewer is required for disputed clusters, clusters containing a shortlisted lead, or clusters whose merge changes a blocking quota.
Every decision is append-only and hash-bound to the comparison artifact.

score_policy.rule: Scoring ranks design hypotheses only. Empirical model outcomes remain null until a separately authorized trial manifest is executed and human-audited.

retry_policy.backoff: adapter-reported Retry-After, otherwise bounded exponential backoff with jitter
retry_policy.rule: Every attempt is ledgered. Exhausted retries pause the stage; they do not silently mark a unit complete.

stages.purpose: Execute the five query strategies through a configured adapter and preserve every returned page and result immutably.
stages.resume_unit: one strategy_id plus query_run_id plus page cursor
completion_criteria: Every planned query is exhausted, completed, or explicitly waived by a human with a reason.
Every response and result has immutable request, response, payload, adapter, provider, rank, and cursor provenance.
Blocking search quotas pass or have a recorded human override where permitted.

stages.purpose: Resolve identifiers and stable source versions, fetch allowed metadata or content, and record content-addressed raw fetch snapshots.
stages.resume_unit: one canonical source request plus version locator
completion_criteria: Every raw search record is linked to a fetched or metadata-only source, excluded with a reason, or marked pending.
Restricted or unknown-license payloads remain outside the repository.
All redirects, content hashes, timestamps, and adapter versions are recorded.

stages.purpose: Create immutable source snapshots and source-grounded problem leads with explicit evidence roles and claim locators.
completion_criteria: Every accepted source snapshot passes provenance, identifier, publication-status, evidence-role, and license validation.
Every problem lead has an explicit objective, TensorCircuit path, oracle design, and claim-to-source mapping.
Search snippets and unverified sources are not used as scientific bases.

stages.purpose: Collapse exact source identities, cluster semantically overlapping problem leads, and obtain reviewable human decisions without discarding provenance.
stages.resume_unit: one exact-identity group or semantic cluster
completion_criteria: Every probable-same and near-duplicate cluster has a human decision or an explicit defer decision.
Required second reviews are complete.
Every retained family links back to all constituent problem leads and source snapshots.
Blocking family and source quotas pass.

stages.purpose: Select a deterministic, quota-aware family pool and expand it across four scales and five operational situations.
stages.resume_unit: one quota stratum followed by one family-scale-situation tuple
completion_criteria: Exactly 50 selected families are expanded over the declared 4-by-5 cross-product.
Exactly 1,000 unique candidate IDs and hashes are produced.
The selection seed, sampler version, input hash, quotas, and human waivers are frozen in the output manifest.

stages.purpose: Apply the frozen eight-perspective design rubric while keeping all empirical model fields empty.
stages.resume_unit: one candidate hash plus rubric version plus scorer identity
completion_criteria: Every candidate has a complete score vector and per-score rationale.
No empirical model-hardness field is populated.
Scores are hash-bound to candidate and source snapshots.

stages.purpose: Select approximately ten candidates for concept review and authorize prototype work only after scientific, framework, and verifier review.
stages.resume_unit: one candidate plus review gate plus reviewer role
completion_criteria: Shortlist quotas pass or all permitted overrides are recorded.
Quantum scientist, TensorCircuit expert, and verifier engineer decisions are distinct and hash-bound.
Rejected and deferred candidates retain reasons and provenance.
No real model trial is launched by this stage; an approved candidate proceeds only to the separate prototype, authorization, and frozen-trial workflow.

required_before_catalog_promotion: all semantic-dedup clusters resolved or explicitly deferred outside the promoted set
promotion diff reviewed by a benchmark owner
promotion_contract.real_test_boundary: Promotion into a discovery catalog or shortlist does not authorize a Harbor/model run. Real tests require the separate frozen manifest and human gates described by the ORBIT-Q problem-discovery workflow.
